acceptanceCriteria: corvint test receipts record a per-unit fingerprint (revision-bound inputs).
runs reusable classifies corvint test units with the same fail-closed rules as Playwright reports.
Tests cover EXACT_PASS and a fingerprint mismatch.
body: V1-1578 (PR #1051) added `corvint runs reusable|fresh` for Playwright reports keyed by test identity + testRevision. `corvint test` (STR-V0) receipts carry no per-unit fingerprint, so its results can never be REUSABLE.
title: corvint test (STR-V0) receipts: per-unit fingerprint so runs reuse covers corvint test results (V1-1578 residual)
